data.sub: You still write the model in Python.

slides.alt: The model, the notebook, and the script stay Python. A Rust core does the fast work in new tools.

data.title: Two layers.
data.you: The model, the notebook, and the script stay Python.
data.under: A Rust core does the fast work in new tools.

slides.alt: You call each one from Python. Hugging Face tokenizers, tiktoken, pydantic-core, Polars, Ruff, and uv run in Rust.

data.title: Tools you already call.
data.lead: You call each one from Python.
data.j2: is the OpenAI tokenizer in Rust.
data.j6: is the package manager in Rust.

slides.alt: pandas 2.2.3 took 365.71 seconds on PDS-H at scale factor 10. The polars streaming 1.30.0 run took 3.89 seconds. This is not every workload, and pandas took 94.0 times as long.

data.title: Factor 94.0
data.machine: The machine had 96 vCPUs and 192 GB.
data.larger: Pandas did not run the larger scale.

slides.alt: Rust has no garbage collector. In the default build, the GIL blocks each CPU-bound thread. Red Hat says a CUDA call releases the GIL.

data.title: Why the new tools use Rust.
data.gil: In the default build, the GIL blocks each CPU-bound thread.
data.cuda: Red Hat says a CUDA call releases the GIL.
data.cpu: A CPU-bound thread does not run with another.
data.io: One thread overlaps another on an I/O wait.

slides.alt: NumPy array math runs as C code. PyTorch tensor code is C++ and CUDA. Rust took new tools, and it did not take this core.

data.title: This core did not move.
data.numpy: NumPy array math runs as C code.
data.torch: PyTorch tensor code is C++ and CUDA.
data.notake: It did not take this core.

slides.alt: Qdrant is a vector database in Rust. LanceDB is Rust, with a Python client. Candle and Burn are optional Rust runtimes, and they do not replace PyTorch.

data.title: Sometimes Rust is the program.
data.qdrant: Qdrant is a vector database in Rust.
data.qclient: A Python client calls that database.
data.lance: LanceDB is Rust, with a Python client.
data.candle: Candle and Burn are optional Rust runtimes.

slides.alt: The default Python build still has the GIL, and free-threaded Python 3.14 is still optional. A vendor benchmark is not your workload. Do not rewrite the model in Rust.

data.title: Before you rewrite.
data.gil: The default Python build still has the GIL.
data.vendor: A vendor benchmark is not your workload.
data.norewrite: Do not rewrite the model in Rust.

slides.alt: Write the model in Python. Profile the slow CPU path, then rewrite that path with PyO3. If you own the tool, Rust can be the program.

data.title: Keep Python for the model.
data.pyo3: Then rewrite that path with PyO3.
data.own: If you own the tool, Rust can be the program.
